note: Curated registry of recurring annual programmes. Authored content, not crawled - see docs/handoffs/PROGRAMMES-REGISTRY-HANDOFF.md. Add-only; never change an existing slug.

programmes.name: SURGE
programmes.description: Students-Undergraduate Research Graduate Excellence is IIT Kanpur's summer research internship programme. It places selected undergraduate students with IIT Kanpur mentors for research exposure.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate students may apply under IIT Kanpur, non-IITK Indian institution, and selected neighbouring-country categories, subject to the current programme rules.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in the early part of the year for a summer internship

programmes.name: SPARK
programmes.description: SPARK is IIT Roorkee's summer internship programme for undergraduate research exposure. Selected interns work with IIT Roorkee faculty on research projects.
programmes.eligibility: Students enrolled in relevant undergraduate or integrated programmes may apply according to IIT Roorkee's current SPARK criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the summer internship period

programmes.name: Summer Research Internship Programme
programmes.description: IIT Gandhinagar's Summer Research Internship Programme brings undergraduate and master's students to campus for faculty-guided research projects. The programme is run as a flagship summer research initiative of IIT Gandhinagar.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate and master's students may apply according to the current SRIP project and applicant rules.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the summer research period

programmes.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Exposure
programmes.description: Summer Undergraduate Research Exposure is IIT Hyderabad's internship programme for non-IIT Hyderabad students. It gives selected students short-term research experience with IIT Hyderabad departments or centres.
programmes.eligibility: Non-IIT Hyderabad students in eligible undergraduate or postgraduate years may apply subject to the current SURE guidelines.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the May-July summer period

programmes.name: Summer Research Fellowship Programme
programmes.description: IIT Delhi's Summer Research Fellowship Programme lets selected undergraduate and postgraduate students work on research and development projects under IIT Delhi faculty. The fellowship is for students outside IIT Delhi.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate and postgraduate applicants from institutes other than IIT Delhi must meet the current academic-rank and programme criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open ahead of the summer vacation period

programmes.name: Summer Fellowship Programme
programmes.description: IIT Madras runs a Summer Fellowship Programme for students to undertake a guided research project with IIT Madras faculty. The programme covers engineering, science, humanities, and management areas according to the current call.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the summer fellowship period

programmes.name: Fellowship for Summer Research
programmes.organiser: IISc Bangalore, Inorganic and Physical Chemistry
programmes.description: The Inorganic and Physical Chemistry department at IISc Bangalore offers a summer research fellowship for chemistry students. Selected students work with an IISc research supervisor for a short summer project.
programmes.eligibility: Chemistry students in eligible B.Sc., integrated M.Sc., B.S., or M.Sc. years may apply according to the current department rules.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the May-July summer period

programmes.name: Research Teaser Internship
programmes.description: IIIT Hyderabad lists Research Teaser Internship offerings among its programmes. These short research-oriented sessions introduce students to selected technical research areas and include project work.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the summer research period

programmes.name: Visiting Students Research Program
programmes.description: The TIFR School of Mathematics Visiting Students Research Program introduces selected bachelor's and master's students to research in mathematics. Participants work through advanced reading courses or appropriate projects with TIFR mathematicians.
programmes.eligibility: Students enrolled in bachelor's or master's programmes may apply according to the current VSRP mathematics criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the summer campus programme

programmes.name: Visiting Students' Research Programme
programmes.description: NCRA-TIFR conducts a Visiting Students' Research Programme in astronomy and astrophysics. Selected students work on theoretical, observational, or computational research projects depending on project availability.
programmes.eligibility: Students in eligible physics, astronomy, applied mathematics, electronics, engineering, or integrated science years may apply according to the current NCRA-TIFR criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in January or February

programmes.name: S. N. Bhatt Memorial Excellence Fellowship Program
programmes.description: ICTS-TIFR's S. N. Bhatt Memorial Excellence Fellowship Program is a summer research programme for science and engineering students. Selected students work with ICTS faculty and postdoctoral fellows on frontier research topics.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate and master's students in science, mathematics, or engineering may apply according to the current ICTS criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications are normally reviewed before the summer programme

programmes.name: Summer Research Program
programmes.description: IISER Mohali's Summer Research Program gives selected students research exposure with IISER Mohali faculty. The programme combines a supervised research component with interdisciplinary course work.
programmes.eligibility: B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent students may apply according to the current IISER Mohali criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the May-July summer period

programmes.name: Science Academies Summer Research Fellowship Program
programmes.organiser: Indian Academy of Sciences, INSA, and NASI
programmes.description: The three Indian science academies offer summer research fellowships for students and teachers to work with academy-associated scientists. Selected fellows undertake short-term research projects with assigned guides.
programmes.eligibility: Students and teachers studying or teaching in India may apply according to the current academy fellowship rules.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open late in the year for fellowships in the following calendar year

programmes.name: Khorana Program for Scholars
programmes.organiser: Department of Biotechnology and Indo-US Science and Technology Forum
programmes.description: The Khorana Program for Scholars supports Indian students in biotechnology and allied areas for research internships at institutions in the United States. The programme is implemented through the Indo-US Science and Technology Forum.
programmes.eligibility: Indian pre-final-year undergraduate and postgraduate students in biotechnology and allied areas may apply according to the current programme rules.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in the earlier part of the year for a summer placement

programmes.name: Summer Research Fellowship Programme
programmes.description: JNCASR's Summer Research Fellowship Programme places selected students with scientists at the centre for a two-month research project. The programme covers physical, materials, chemical, biological, and engineering sciences according to the current call.
programmes.eligibility: Students in eligible B.Sc., B.E., B.Tech., M.Sc., M.E., M.Tech., or integrated programme years may apply according to the current JNCASR subject criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the summer research period

programmes.name: NIUS Physics and Astronomy
programmes.description: The National Initiative on Undergraduate Science in Physics and Astronomy is run by HBCSE-TIFR. It selects undergraduate students for a structured association involving camps and academic mentoring.
programmes.eligibility: First-year undergraduate students may apply according to the current NIUS Physics and Astronomy criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the first NIUS camp

programmes.name: DoS/ISRO Internship and Student Project Trainee Schemes
programmes.description: ISRO lists internship and student project trainee schemes for students to work in Department of Space and ISRO centres. Allotment depends on centre expertise, project availability, facilities, and course fit.
programmes.eligibility: Indian citizens pursuing or recently completing eligible UG, PG, or PhD study in science or technology may apply according to ISRO's scheme rules.
programmes.typical_window: requests are accepted through the year, subject to centre and mentor availability

programmes.name: Paid Internship Scheme
programmes.description: DRDO laboratories periodically invite applications for paid internships from undergraduate and postgraduate engineering or science students. Opportunities are published by individual DRDO labs and establishments.
programmes.typical_window: openings are announced by individual laboratories through the year

programmes.name: Digital India Internship Scheme
programmes.organiser: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
programmes.description: The Digital India Internship Scheme gives students practical work experience under supervisors or mentors in MeitY-linked domains. The scheme is run by India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
programmes.typical_window: the scheme announces intake rounds during the year

programmes.name: NITI Aayog Internship Scheme
programmes.description: The NITI Aayog Internship Scheme allows selected students and research scholars to work with NITI Aayog verticals, divisions, and cells. The work is policy-oriented and spans multiple development sectors.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate, postgraduate, and research scholars enrolled in recognized universities or institutions in India or abroad may apply according to NITI Aayog guidelines.
programmes.typical_window: applications are accepted from the 1st to 10th day of each month

programmes.name: Research Internship
programmes.description: The Reserve Bank of India offers a research internship for students interested in central banking, economics, finance, and policy research. Details and application information are published through RBI's opportunities portal.
programmes.typical_window: openings are announced on the bank's website when available

programmes.name: Young Professional Program and Internship
programmes.description: SEBI publishes young professional and internship opportunities across domains such as securities market operations, law, research, information technology, and language. Notices and results are listed on SEBI's official internship page.
programmes.typical_window: openings are announced on the regulator's website when available

programmes.name: Practical Training and Project Work
programmes.description: BARC allows eligible science and engineering students to apply for practical training or project work during their academic curriculum. Applications are routed through college or institution authorities and screened by BARC.
programmes.eligibility: Eligible science and engineering undergraduate or postgraduate students may apply through their institution according to BARC's current student-corner rules.
programmes.typical_window: applications are routed through the student's institution ahead of each training period

programmes.name: Summer Training Program
programmes.description: CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology runs a Summer Training Program for selected students. The programme gives students short-term laboratory research exposure at CCMB.
programmes.eligibility: Students in eligible B.Sc., M.Sc., B.Tech., B.Pharm., or integrated programme years may apply according to the current CCMB criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open before the May-July summer period

programmes.name: Google Summer of Code
programmes.description: Google Summer of Code is an annual open-source contribution programme run by Google with participating open-source organisations. Contributors work on mentored projects and submit code to public projects.
programmes.typical_window: annual programme timeline varies by year

programmes.name: Outreachy
programmes.description: Outreachy provides paid remote internships with open-source and open-science communities. The programme focuses on applicants affected by underrepresentation, systemic bias, or discrimination in technology.
programmes.typical_window: internship rounds usually run twice a year

programmes.name: LFX Mentorship
programmes.description: The Linux Foundation Mentorship Program connects new contributors with mentors across Linux Foundation open-source projects. Mentees learn, experiment, and contribute to project communities.
programmes.typical_window: Linux Foundation lists spring, summer, and fall mentorship terms

programmes.name: MLH Fellowship
programmes.description: The MLH Fellowship is a remote internship alternative for aspiring software engineers. Its open-source track places fellows in pods to contribute to real-world open-source projects with mentorship.
programmes.typical_window: applications are processed by cohort and close before each batch

programmes.name: Season of KDE
programmes.description: Season of KDE is KDE's mentorship programme for people contributing to KDE software and community projects. Participants work with KDE mentors on selected free-software tasks.
programmes.typical_window: annual programme timeline varies by KDE cycle

programmes.name: Hyperledger Mentorship Program
programmes.description: The Hyperledger mentorship programme has moved under LF Decentralized Trust. It provides structured learning opportunities for new contributors to blockchain and distributed ledger open-source projects.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in the earlier part of the year for a mid-year mentorship term

programmes.name: Summer of Bitcoin
programmes.description: Summer of Bitcoin is a global online summer internship programme focused on Bitcoin open-source development and design. Students contribute to Bitcoin projects under mentor guidance.
programmes.typical_window: annual summer programme

programmes.name: Globalink Research Internship
programmes.description: Mitacs Globalink Research Internship places selected international undergraduates with Canadian university faculty for a full-time research internship. Projects span science, engineering, mathematics, humanities, and social sciences.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduates from eligible countries and partner institutions may apply according to the current Mitacs country-specific criteria.
programmes.typical_window: student applications usually open well before the following year's internship period

programmes.name: Summer Student Programme
programmes.description: CERN's Summer Student Programme lets selected bachelor's and master's students work on scientific or technical projects at CERN. Students also attend lectures and take part in the CERN summer student community.
programmes.eligibility: Bachelor's or master's students in physics, engineering, computer science, or mathematics may apply according to CERN's current criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually close early in the year for the summer programme

programmes.name: RISE Germany
programmes.description: RISE Germany offers summer research internships at German universities and research institutes. Undergraduate students are matched with doctoral-student mentors in science and engineering fields.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate students from eligible countries may apply according to DAAD RISE Germany rules.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in autumn for the following year's internships

programmes.name: France Excellence Charpak Summer Training Scholarship
programmes.description: The France Excellence Charpak Summer Training Scholarship supports Indian students undertaking a short research internship or project at a French laboratory or institution. Applicants must arrange an invitation from the host laboratory or institution.
programmes.eligibility: Indian bachelor's or master's students enrolled in an Indian institution may apply according to the current Campus France India criteria.
programmes.typical_window: supports internships or research projects during the academic summer break

programmes.name: Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award
programmes.description: The Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award supports short-term research attachments for international students at A*STAR research institutes and consortia. The award gives students exposure to Singapore's research environment.
programmes.typical_window: intakes run in cycles through the year, with deadlines ahead of each start date

programmes.name: Visiting Student Research Program
programmes.description: KAUST's Visiting Student Research Program offers research internships for advanced bachelor's and master's students in STEM fields. Interns work with KAUST faculty on projects for a flexible research period.
programmes.eligibility: Third- and fourth-year bachelor's students and master's students in STEM may apply according to KAUST's current criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications are project-based and flexible through the year

programmes.name: Student Summer Research Fellowship
programmes.organiser: ETH Zurich Department of Computer Science
programmes.description: The ETH Student Summer Research Fellowship offers undergraduate and graduate students research experience in computer science at ETH Zurich. Fellows work with a research group in one of the department's listed areas.
programmes.eligibility: Bachelor's and master's students worldwide, except ETH Zurich students, may apply according to the current fellowship criteria.
programmes.typical_window: fellowship work takes place during the July-August summer period

programmes.name: Amgen Scholars Program
programmes.description: The Amgen Scholars Program gives undergraduates summer research opportunities at host institutions across multiple regions. Participants conduct a research project and join seminars, networking events, and a regional symposium.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate students apply through participating host institutions under the current regional and host-specific criteria.
programmes.typical_window: summer research programme with host-specific application windows

programmes.name: Microsoft Research Internships
programmes.description: Microsoft Research posts research internship roles across its global research labs. Interns work with Microsoft researchers on projects in computing and related disciplines.
programmes.typical_window: roles are posted on Microsoft Research careers when open

programmes.name: Adobe Research Internships
programmes.description: Adobe Research offers research and engineering internships for graduate students. Interns collaborate with Adobe researchers and product teams across research areas.
programmes.eligibility: Graduate students may apply according to the current Adobe Research internship call.
programmes.typical_window: internship roles are posted by Adobe Research when open

programmes.name: Student Researcher Program
programmes.description: Google's Student Researcher Program hires students onto research, science, and engineering projects across Google teams. Projects are matched by role, degree level, location, and team needs.
programmes.eligibility: Students enrolled in bachelor's, master's, or PhD programmes may apply according to the current role and location criteria.
programmes.typical_window: roles are posted on Google Careers when open

programmes.name: Amazon Science Internships
programmes.description: Amazon Science lists internship roles in applied science, research science, machine learning, data science, and related fields. Interns work with Amazon scientists and engineers on applied research problems.
programmes.typical_window: roles are posted on Amazon Science careers when open

programmes.name: Smart India Hackathon
programmes.organiser: Ministry of Education Innovation Cell and AICTE
programmes.description: Smart India Hackathon is a nationwide student innovation competition focused on solving problem statements from government, industry, and other organisations. It includes software and hardware tracks in different editions.
programmes.typical_window: annual competition timeline varies by edition

programmes.name: TCS CodeVita
programmes.description: TCS CodeVita is TCS's online programming competition for students. It is built around competitive programming problems and has been used as a student engagement and hiring pathway.
programmes.typical_window: annual competition timeline varies by season

programmes.name: HackWithInfy
programmes.description: HackWithInfy is Infosys's coding competition for engineering students. Participants compete through coding rounds and selected performers may receive further Infosys opportunities according to the current edition rules.
programmes.typical_window: annual competition timeline varies by edition

programmes.name: Code for Good
programmes.description: Code for Good is JPMorgan Chase's student hackathon programme where participants build technology solutions for nonprofit organisations. The programme has run in multiple locations over multiple years.
programmes.typical_window: recruitment usually runs during the campus hiring season ahead of the event

programmes.name: International Collegiate Programming Contest
programmes.description: The International Collegiate Programming Contest is a team-based algorithmic programming contest for college students. University teams progress through regional contests toward global finals.
programmes.eligibility: College-student teams participate through ICPC regional contest rules.
programmes.typical_window: regional contest schedules vary by region each year

programmes.name: IISc Summer Research Internships
programmes.description: IISc hosts undergraduate and master's students for two- to three-month research projects with institute faculty, reached through the department and lab openings listed by the institute's outreach office.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate and master's students with strong academic records may apply, subject to the current criteria of the hosting department or lab.
programmes.typical_window: openings are listed through the year, with most projects running over the summer

programmes.name: IRCC Research Internship Award (RIA)
programmes.description: The Industrial Research and Consultancy Centre at IIT Bombay awards research internships that place students with IIT Bombay faculty on funded research projects.
programmes.eligibility: Students from recognised institutions may apply under the award's current criteria; selection is made by the hosting faculty member.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in the early part of the year for a summer internship

programmes.name: Summer Internship Programme
programmes.description: NIT Rourkela runs a summer internship programme that places students from other institutions with its faculty for short research projects.
programmes.eligibility: Students enrolled at other recognised institutions may apply according to NIT Rourkela's current internship criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in the early part of the year for a summer internship

programmes.name: Visiting Students' Research Programme (VSRP)
programmes.description: TIFR's institute-wide Visiting Students' Research Programme hosts students across its schools for a summer of supervised research; individual schools and centres also run their own VSRP tracks.
programmes.eligibility: Students in relevant science and engineering programmes may apply under the criteria published by TIFR and its participating schools.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in the early part of the year for a summer programme

programmes.name: PM Internship Scheme
programmes.description: A central government scheme that places young people in internships with participating Indian companies, administered through a common online portal.
programmes.eligibility: Indian youth within the age band and qualification criteria published by the scheme; candidates in full-time employment or full-time study are generally excluded.
programmes.typical_window: application rounds are announced on the scheme portal and run for a few weeks at a time

programmes.name: MEA Internship Programme
programmes.description: The Ministry of External Affairs hosts students for short internships exposing them to India's foreign policy work and the functioning of the ministry.
programmes.eligibility: Indian students in eligible undergraduate, postgraduate or research programmes, per the criteria published for each round.
programmes.typical_window: the ministry announces intake rounds during the year

programmes.name: Supreme Court of India Internship
programmes.description: The Supreme Court of India offers structured internships giving law students exposure to court proceedings and judicial work.
programmes.eligibility: Law students meeting the year-of-study and other criteria published by the Court for each internship period.
programmes.typical_window: internships are offered in defined slots through the year

programmes.name: LAMP Fellowship
programmes.description: Legislative Assistants to Members of Parliament places young graduates with a Member of Parliament for a parliamentary year to support legislative and policy research.
programmes.eligibility: Indian graduates meeting the age and qualification criteria published for the cohort; no specific discipline is required.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open several months before the parliamentary year begins

programmes.name: Young India Fellowship
programmes.description: A one-year postgraduate liberal studies programme at Ashoka University combining a multidisciplinary curriculum with an experiential project.
programmes.eligibility: Graduates across disciplines who meet the fellowship's published criteria; selection includes written application and interview stages.
programmes.typical_window: applications are accepted in rounds across the admissions cycle

programmes.name: Teach For India Fellowship
programmes.description: A two-year full-time fellowship placing graduates and professionals as full-time teachers in under-resourced classrooms across partner cities.
programmes.eligibility: Indian citizens and OCI holders who have completed a bachelor's degree by the time the fellowship begins, per the published criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications are accepted in rounds over several months before the cohort starts

programmes.name: SBI Youth for India Fellowship
programmes.description: A rural development fellowship placing young professionals with partner NGOs to work on grassroots projects for around thirteen months.
programmes.eligibility: Indian citizens and OCI holders within the published age band holding a graduate degree from a recognised institution.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in the middle of the year for a cohort starting later that year

programmes.name: Gandhi Fellowship
programmes.description: A two-year fellowship in which fellows work on public education and community transformation projects alongside government school systems.
programmes.eligibility: Graduates within the published age band; selection runs through application, assessment and interview stages.
programmes.typical_window: recruitment runs in cycles across the year

programmes.name: INSPIRE Scholarship (SHE)
programmes.description: The Scholarship for Higher Education component of the INSPIRE programme supports students pursuing basic and natural sciences at the undergraduate and postgraduate level.
programmes.eligibility: Students meeting the DST's published performance criteria who are enrolled in eligible natural science courses.
programmes.typical_window: the call for applications is published on the INSPIRE portal each cycle

programmes.name: Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation Scholarship
programmes.description: Supports Indian students pursuing postgraduate study at selected universities abroad across a broad range of disciplines.
programmes.eligibility: Indian citizens resident in India who hold a good first degree and meet the foundation's age and admission criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open early in the year for study starting that autumn

programmes.name: J. N. Tata Endowment Loan Scholarship
programmes.description: A long-running loan scholarship for Indian graduates pursuing higher studies abroad, awarded across disciplines.
programmes.eligibility: Indian nationals who are graduates of a recognised university and meet the endowment's published criteria.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in the earlier part of the year

programmes.name: Fulbright-Nehru Fellowships
programmes.description: USIEF administers the Fulbright-Nehru fellowships supporting Indian students, scholars and professionals for study and research in the United States.
programmes.eligibility: Indian citizens meeting the criteria of the specific fellowship category being applied for.
programmes.typical_window: each fellowship category has its own annual deadline published by USIEF

programmes.name: Commonwealth Scholarships and Fellowships
programmes.organiser: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
programmes.description: Funds students and professionals from Commonwealth countries for master's, PhD and other programmes in the United Kingdom.
programmes.eligibility: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries who meet the academic and, for some awards, nominating-body requirements.
programmes.typical_window: each award type has its own annual deadline published by the Commission

programmes.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarships
programmes.description: Scholarships covering integrated master's programmes delivered jointly by university consortia across multiple European countries.
programmes.eligibility: Open to students worldwide; each joint master's programme sets its own academic entry requirements.
programmes.typical_window: individual programmes publish their own deadlines, commonly in the earlier part of the year

programmes.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
programmes.organiser: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation
programmes.description: Supports postgraduate researchers and artists from selected countries to pursue research or study at Swiss public universities and research institutes.
programmes.eligibility: Applicants from eligible countries meeting the academic criteria; a Swiss host institution or supervisor is normally required.
programmes.typical_window: country-specific calls are published annually, commonly in the second half of the year

programmes.name: Reliance Foundation Scholarships
programmes.description: Merit-based scholarships for Indian undergraduate and postgraduate students, with dedicated tracks for selected fields.
programmes.eligibility: Indian students meeting the academic and income criteria published for each scholarship track.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open after the academic year's admissions conclude

programmes.name: Aditya Birla Scholarship
programmes.description: Awarded to students at selected leading Indian institutes across engineering, management and law, based on academic and leadership merit.
programmes.eligibility: Students enrolled at the partner institutions listed by the programme, per its published criteria.
programmes.typical_window: candidates are identified through the partner institutes during the academic year

programmes.name: Narotam Sekhsaria Foundation Scholarship
programmes.description: An interest-free loan scholarship for Indian students pursuing postgraduate study in India or abroad across a wide set of disciplines.
programmes.eligibility: Indian nationals within the published age band who hold or expect a strong first degree.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in the earlier part of the year

programmes.name: Hacktoberfest
programmes.description: An annual month-long event encouraging contributions to participating open-source repositories, aimed at newcomers as well as experienced contributors.
programmes.eligibility: Open to anyone who registers during the event window; contributions must be to participating repositories.
programmes.typical_window: runs through October each year, with registration opening shortly before

programmes.name: Google Season of Docs
programmes.description: Connects technical writers with open-source organisations to improve project documentation over a defined project period.
programmes.eligibility: Participation is arranged through accepted open-source organisations; requirements are set by the programme for each edition.
programmes.typical_window: organisations apply first, with the writing period later in the year

programmes.name: Meta Hacker Cup
programmes.description: An annual open algorithmic programming contest run in successive online rounds leading to a final.
programmes.eligibility: Open to participants who register and meet the contest's published rules and age requirements.
programmes.typical_window: registration and the qualification round usually fall in the second half of the year

programmes.name: Microsoft Imagine Cup
programmes.description: A global student technology competition in which teams build and pitch a software project through successive judging rounds.
programmes.eligibility: Student teams meeting the enrolment and age criteria published in the competition's official rules.
programmes.typical_window: registration opens in the autumn with rounds running into the following year

programmes.name: IBM Research India Internships
programmes.description: IBM's India research lab hosts student interns on projects spanning artificial intelligence, systems and adjacent research areas.
programmes.eligibility: Students in relevant degree programmes; specific requirements depend on the project and are set by the hiring team.
programmes.typical_window: openings are posted through the year, with many internships running over the summer

programmes.name: NVIDIA Research Internships
programmes.description: NVIDIA Research hosts graduate and undergraduate interns on projects in areas such as graphics, machine learning and computer architecture.
programmes.eligibility: Students in relevant degree programmes; requirements vary by research area and are set in each posting.
programmes.typical_window: applications for summer internships usually open in the preceding months

programmes.name: MIT Summer Research Program (MSRP)
programmes.description: A summer programme placing undergraduate students in MIT research groups with faculty and graduate-student mentorship.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate students meeting the programme's published criteria; some tracks have nationality or institution requirements.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open in the winter for a summer placement

programmes.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowships (SURF)
programmes.description: Caltech's flagship summer research fellowship, in which students write a project proposal with a mentor and carry it out over the summer.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate students meeting the programme's published criteria; some options are limited to Caltech students.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually close in the earlier part of the year for a summer project

programmes.name: NUS Research Attachment Programmes
programmes.description: NUS hosts visiting students on research attachments with its faculty across science and engineering disciplines.
programmes.eligibility: Students from partner and eligible institutions meeting the academic criteria published for each attachment.
programmes.typical_window: intakes are announced ahead of each attachment period

programmes.name: JSPS Summer Program
programmes.organiser: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science
programmes.description: Places pre- and postdoctoral researchers from participating countries in Japanese host laboratories for a summer of research, alongside an orientation in Japanese language and culture.
programmes.eligibility: Researchers from participating countries, nominated through the designated partner agency, per the programme's criteria.
programmes.typical_window: nominating agencies run their own calls, generally well ahead of the summer

programmes.name: IAESTE Internships
programmes.description: An international exchange network arranging technical internships abroad for science, engineering and applied-arts students through member country committees.
programmes.eligibility: Students at institutions affiliated with a national IAESTE committee, per that committee's process.
programmes.typical_window: national committees run their own selection cycles, commonly in the winter for summer placements

programmes.name: Heidelberg Laureate Forum
programmes.description: An annual week-long forum bringing selected young researchers in mathematics and computer science together with laureates of the field's major prizes.
programmes.eligibility: Undergraduate, graduate and postdoctoral researchers in mathematics or computer science, selected through an application process.
programmes.typical_window: applications usually open around the turn of the year for a forum held in the autumn
